label: D1 after a reward from S2, strongest when S2 was reached rarely from a1
explanation: Fires only at D1 and only when the reward input is 1 (100% of activations are rewarded D1 steps; never at GO/D2, never after no reward). Within rewarded D1s it fires essentially only when the previous trial ended in S2 (prev_state != 1 gives 100% recall; prev_state==2 holds 87% of mass; the rest is window-first trials where prev is unknown). The strongest activations (top quartile 87% covered) come after a rare-rewarded trial: choose a1, land in S2, get rewarded, i.e. the model-based switch signal toward a2 (prev_action==1 & prev_state==2 alone: P=0.55, R=0.55, mass 0.76). Weaker activations come after common a2->S2 rewards, concentrated early in the episode (ep_trial < 10 rate 5x; activation rate decays steadily with ep_trial). Recorded disjunction: rare a1->S2 reward, or any S2 reward in the first 10 trials (dev P=0.52, R=0.72, F1=0.60, mass 0.84). Does not fire after S1 rewards (including a2->S1 rare rewards), after unrewarded trials, or off D1. All variables used are observed at D1.
